description: Defines a global exception handler for the Person Service API, handling various application and validation exceptions to produce standardized HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring REST controller advice that globally handles exceptions thrown within the application, providing appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handlePersonServiceException
methods.description: Handles custom PersonServiceException, mapping specific error types to HTTP status codes and constructing ApiError responses.

methods.name: handleMethodArgumentNotValid
methods.description: Handles validation errors for method arguments, aggregating field errors into a response.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolation
methods.description: Handles validation constraint violations, returning a standardized error response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Catches all other exceptions, returning a generic internal server error response.
